verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for an online registrar and email provider that holds account, contact, and email data, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents choosing a storage region or residency. WHOIS privacy, account locks, and SSL are related privacy controls, not region selection, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
